variants.role: General information, chart, and record surface
variants.centralUsage: Shared card surface; domain pages compose content inside it rather than setting presentation literals.

variants.role: Compact key metric within a metric grid
variants.centralUsage: Shared metric anatomy and joined/independent layout are controlled by the presentation layer.
Shared table radius and header/cell cadence; domains own columns and business states.

variants.role: Search, select, and period filter container
variants.centralUsage: Presentation controls the outer workbench; a domain chooses which filters are meaningful.

evidence.remaining: Period/date popover geometry and multi-filter comparison fixture.

variants.centralUsage: Shared dialog shell; domains own fields, detail rows, and approval actions.

evidence.remaining: Width, scroll region, and nested table/form measurements.

variants.role: Batch, stepper, and staged workspace panel
variants.centralUsage: Shared workflow frame; each business process owns its stages and permissions.
variants.referenceArchetype: Structured form and tabbed record workflow

exceptions.scope: POS, receipt, catalog, execution, recipe, internal registration
exceptions.rationale: Interactive transaction and print layouts require an explicit receipt/form variant; they must not be normalized by a blanket card rule.

exceptions.scope: Attendance roster, employee profile, onboarding, payroll dialogs, employee PWA
exceptions.rationale: People workflow grids and the employee portal have interaction and privacy constraints outside the generic shell.

exceptions.scope: Safe bindings: accounts/invoice loading and empty records, report overview/documents records, VAT scope/table. Exception: treasury/ledger density and the report prototype canvas/drawer.
exceptions.rationale: The safe surfaces use BaseerCard record, form-or-receipt, or joined-ledger variants. The financial report canvas and drawers remain custom because their evidence layout and scroll regions need a dedicated geometry fixture rather than a blanket card rule.

asserts: read/detail receipts for ledger, treasury, P&L and VAT pass on the modern administrative interface in RTL desktop and mobile
ledger and VAT header/cell cadence remains readable
treasury activity reaches its journal source and P&L/VAT dialogs mount
evidence.remaining: Read/detail fixture acceptance is complete for this finance/reports exception. Mutation workflows and unrelated report families remain outside this bounded contract.

exceptions.scope: Decision timeline, marketing timeline/campaigns, inbound evidence rules and labels
exceptions.rationale: Timelines and evidence labels are data-rich semantic surfaces; bridge CSS is not a geometry acceptance proof.
